source_instruction: i need a high quality bed cover that is easy to clean. find something in purple.
query:
I spent my whole Saturday morning deep cleaning my sunroom, which has turned into my little unofficial plant hospital lately. I rescued a sad, crispy fiddle leaf fig from the curb outside my neighbor’s house last week, and I’ve been fussing over it like it’s a sick toddler—misting its leaves every couple hours, rotating it to catch the perfect slant of afternoon sun, even mixing up a little diluted banana peel water to feed it because I saw that hack on TikTok. My cat Mochi spent the entire time I was cleaning knocking over the small terracotta pots I lined up on the windowsill, like she was personally offended I was rearranging “her” sun napping spots, so I had to stop twice to fish potting soil out of her fluffy white fur before she tracked it all over the living room carpet.
Hey there, I’m browsing through your salon & spa equipment section looking for some high quality pieces that are scratch resistant, y’know? I need to stick to that usual budget cap I always go with when I’m picking up gear for my home treatment room, so don’t show me anything that goes over that one. I’m really only drawn to pieces in my go-to favorite color for all my salon setup stuff, so make sure you filter for that when you’re pulling up options for me, yeah? I don’t want to waste time scrolling through stuff that doesn’t fit what I’m after for my space.
